iti11:1.1: (Ek. II.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti11:2.1: Mohaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya. Mohañca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā-ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti11:3.1: Yena mohena mūḷhāse sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ | taṃ mohaṃ sammad-aññāya pajahanti vipassino | pahāya na punāyanti imaṃ lokaṃ kudācanan-ti ||
iti11:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||1||
